notes: Prototype extension. The empty budget wallet adds no money or scheduled contribution. Benefit copy in the container model is illustrative, not a live product offer. Personalised rates are illustrative scenario offers, not live HSBC pricing. Loan interest is 0% to preserve the existing £150 × 24 repayment example. These display terms do not change the projection engine or credit interest ledger. Arrangements use calendar-month demo assessments. Manual and automated receipts qualify equally. Lock and merchant choices require explicit review. No automatic missed-condition penalties are implemented. September story expansion: fictional opening snapshots include spending wallets and shared households. The grocery-wallet recovery example alone defines a missed-month cashback change and a next-month route back; it is not a general HSBC policy.
